## Use Victor Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Victor Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Victor Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

## About the Victor Mono coding font

A programming font with a handwritten feel. Victor Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Victor Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Victor Mono FAQ

### Is Victor Mono free?

Yes. Victor Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Victor Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Victor Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Victor Mono?

Victor Mono is available from GitHub and Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
